featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who leads Codex & ChatGPT at OpenAI, announced a new ChatGPT mobile experience: favorite features are easier to reach, your "dot" gets its own tab, and Codex, Projects, Images and more can be pinned to the tab bar. It starts with Pro users who have or are eligible to create a dot; some will see it by default, and it can be toggled under Settings > New ChatGPT Design. He dubbed it "ChatGPT 2.0" and admitted the team is bold enough to try improving an experience used by 1.2B users in place — "let'…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布 ChatGPT 正在推出新的移动端体验：常用功能更容易找到，个人的 “dot” 有独立标签页，Codex、Projects、Images 等可以固定到底部标签栏。首批面向已有或有资格创建 dot 的 Pro 用户，部分用户会默认看到，可在 Settings > New ChatGPT Design 中随时开关。他把这次改版称为 “ChatGPT 2.0”，并坦言团队在“原地改造 12 亿用户正在用的产品”，策略能否奏效还有待观察。

featured.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
featured.summaryEn: Josh Woodward, VP at Google overseeing Google Labs, the Gemini app and AI Studio, announced that the Gemini app on Mac can now do tasks on your computer — one of the most-requested features. Desktop computer use is quickly becoming table stakes for AI assistants.
featured.insightZh: Google Labs、Gemini App 与 AI Studio 负责人 Josh Woodward 宣布：Mac 版 Gemini 应用现在可以直接在你的电脑上执行任务，这是呼声最高的功能请求之一。桌面端 computer-use 能力正在成为各家助手的标配战场。

featured.title: Superintelligence Needs the Physical World with Arda CEO Bob McGrew
featured.summaryEn: Former OpenAI Chief Research Officer Bob McGrew argues that automating researchers won't trigger a hard takeoff because the bottleneck is physical — GPUs, wet labs, factories — which is why he founded Arda to make automated production lines as easy to reconfigure as retraining human workers. Bob McGrew, an early Palantir executive and later OpenAI's Chief Research Officer, is now CEO and co-founder of Arda. He calls the RSI hard-takeoff argument "straightforwardly wrong": researchers aren't the bottleneck, experiments are. At OpenAI in 2024 the limit was GPUs and how they were networked, not headcount. Automated research may be a huge one-time boost — comparable to going from GPT-4o to o3 with reasoning — pushing GPU "discovery efficiency" from ~35% toward 90%, but 90% to 99% barely matters: it's another S-curve, not a self-improvement loop. Better simulation in biology or materials yie…
featured.insightZh: 前 OpenAI 首席研究官 Bob McGrew 认为“自动化研究员就能引爆硬起飞”是错的——瓶颈在 GPU、湿实验室和工厂这些物理世界，因此他创办 Arda，用 AI 让产线像重新培训工人一样快速重构。 Bob McGrew 曾是 Palantir 早期核心高管和 OpenAI 首席研究官，现在是 Arda 的 CEO 兼联合创始人。他开场就反驳 RSI 硬起飞论：研究员并不是瓶颈，实验才是。2024 年他在 OpenAI 时，真正的限制是手头 GPU 的数量和互联方式，而不是招到多少研究员。自动化研究可能带来类似从 GPT-4o 到 o3 推理那样的一次性巨大加速，把 GPU“产出发现”的效率从约 35% 提到 90%，但从 90% 到 99% 意义不大——这是又一条 S 曲线，而不是自我改进循环。生物、材料等领域即便模拟更好，也只是一次性加速，之后仍会撞上物理世界。他用 Ilya 的口头禅佐证：听完论文讲解，Ilya 只问“结果呢？”——深度学习本质上是实验科学。他还举了“推土机悖论”：要建数据中心缺推土机，AI 决定建推土机工厂，第一步是平整土地——需要推土机。 Arda 要解决的是美国制造业竞争力问题：美国擅长设计但不擅长制造，根源是人工成本，出路是自动化产线。但 iPhone 每年约 75% 零件更换，只有 25% 是高度自动化的，其余靠手工，因为传统自动化是专用定制机器，不能跨代泛化。Arda 的目标是让重构自动化产线像重新培训人类工人一样容易：上传产品设计，7 天内设计并重构自动化产线。适用场景是高混线、高频迭代的行业：国防（乌克兰前线变化几周内就要反映到设计）、消费电子、数据中心供应链。他认为装配线是“封闭世界”机器人问题，两条甚至一条手臂加相机就够，不需要人形机器人；机械臂精度早已够用，问题在经济性和设计+标定的工程成本。Arda 过去一年与 Anduril 合作打造制造工程软件平台——相当于先为制造工程师造出“IDE + Git”，再在上面加 agent（“做制造业的 Cursor”）；首位用户把执行器的虚拟装配从几天缩短到 90 分钟，现已覆…

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared his "is engineering a valuable pursuit" math: an outcome-oriented, creative engineer is now a 1000x engineer; a tabs-vs-spaces-debating, miss-the-forest engineer is a -10x engineer; the regular knowledge worker is now a 2x engineer. He says this matches the token-consumption distribution Vercel sees across startups and enterprises, and that coding is AI's #1 killer app, as Anthropic's success shows. He also described Vercel Board as infra, not product — a "headless Slack" for agen…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 给出了他的“工程师价值算术”：以结果为导向、有创造力的工程师现在是 1000x 工程师；纠结 tabs 还是 spaces、只见树木不见森林的工程师是 -10x；普通知识工作者则相当于 2x 工程师。他说这与 Vercel 在初创和企业客户中看到的 token 消耗分布一致，工程师和“软件工厂”会消耗指数级更多的 token；Anthropic 的成功说明编程是 AI 的头号杀手级应用。他还介绍了 Vercel Board：没有重量级 UI，是基础设施而非产品，像 agent 的 “headless Slack” 或 Redux 状态管理器——因为 UI 现在是免费的，每个场景都可以生成自己的“工厂界面”，Vercel 内部有些工厂就是纯 TUI 或通过 Slack agent 管理。另一句：“公司的起源，是帮你建公司的那个 agent。”

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者、产品人
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang posted a video comparing Gemini 4 Neon with Opus 5.5, his favorite everyday model. Takeaways: Opus is still better at 3D and design, but Neon is on par or better at writing and personality — a huge accomplishment; of Gemini 4's three models, he expects to use Neon for 99% of tasks since it's much faster than Carbon with results just as good; and the $100/mo Gemini Ultra bundle (Gemini 4, YouTube Premium Family, 20 TB storage) is a steal. He also argued Google's 100,000+ employees do…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 发布了 Gemini 4 Neon 与 Opus 5.5（他日常工作最爱用的模型）的对比视频。结论：Opus 在 3D 和设计上仍更强，但 Neon 在写作和“个性”上持平甚至更好，这是不小的成就；Gemini 4 有三个模型，但他认为 99% 的任务会用 Neon——比 Carbon 快得多，效果一样好；每月 100 美元的 Gemini Ultra 订阅（含 Gemini 4、YouTube Premium 家庭版、20TB 存储）“简直是白送”。他还指出 Google 被嘲笑庞大官僚，但 10 万+ 员工在正式发布前内测模型和工具本身就是竞争优势，规模大到员工内部 A/B 测试都能达到统计显著。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal, GP at South Park Commons, congratulated Anthropic and used the moment to explain SPC's purpose: Tom Brown arrived at SPC in 2016 with no ML background, worked through papers with other members, then co-founded Anthropic; Thariq joined after winding down his gaming company, was working on interpretability when a fellow member asked if he'd tried Claude Code, and soon helped build it. "If you put ambitious people next to each other, it leads to extraordinary things. Sometimes the impact comes years l…
items.insightZh: South Park Commons（SPC）普通合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 祝贺 Anthropic，并借此解释 SPC 的意义：Tom Brown 2016 年来到 SPC 时毫无 ML 背景，和其他成员一起啃论文，后来联合创立 Anthropic；Thariq 刚关掉游戏公司后加入 SPC 做可解释性研究，被同伴问“试过 Claude Code 吗”，随后加入并参与打造了这个大家每天在用的工具。“把有野心的人放在一起，会产生非凡的事，有时影响要多年后才显现。”他还推荐了 Fig 的 RoleCUA：agent 正从单个任务走向完整岗位，RoleCUA 把专家角色在数月真实工作中的每个动作都关联到对应任务和目标。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq, formerly on Claude Code at Anthropic, shared his AIE Code talk: software is both art and utility, and AI is both an Industrial Revolution and a Renaissance. "Factories are for utilities" — his talk was about how we can make better art.
items.insightZh: 前 Anthropic Claude Code 成员 Thariq 分享了他在 AIE Code 的演讲：软件既是艺术也是工具，AI 既是一场工业革命也是一场文艺复兴；“工厂是为工具准备的”，他讲的是我们如何做出更好的“艺术”。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad showed how to build your own Muse-like personal agent with one prompt, and predicted that "having a contract with your agent" is a paradigm many will copy from Replit.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 演示了用一条 prompt 构建类似 Muse 的个人 agent，并表示“和你的 agent 签订合同”这种范式会被很多人效仿。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari asked who is securing the elderly as network attacks and impersonation rise. He sketched four layers: the browser (a secure browser, since scam texts lead to links), the network (a Pi-hole-like device or Onavo-style VPN blocking unsafe sites), payments (flag scam-like transactions before money leaves), and the phone itself (full monitoring, calls only from loved ones, cloned voices caught by providers like Reality Defender). Point solutions exist but nothing is neatly packaged;…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 提出一个问题：网络攻击和冒充诈骗频发，谁在保护老人？他梳理了四个可能的防护层：浏览器层（安全浏览器，因为诈骗短信最终都导向链接）、网络层（类似 Pi-hole 的硬件或 Onavo 式 VPN 拦截不安全网站）、支付层（在钱转出前标记疑似诈骗交易）、手机层（全面监控，只接亲人来电，用 Reality Defender 之类识别克隆语音）。目前有单点方案但没有打包产品，可以再叠加保险对齐激励；买单的是像他这样的子女。另外他吐槽现在又流行 “PR-maxxing”，呼吁关注 what/who/why 而不是 how。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创始人
items.summaryEn: Swyx (Latent Space, AI Engineer) warned that on social media you can post "odds of reaching SOTA have dropped to zero," get lots of likes, then post an apology three months later when they hit SOTA and get even more — and the subject thanks you for the motivation. There are no consequences for inaccuracy, every incentive for hyperbole, and the X algorithm is tuned for it.
items.insightZh: Latent Space 与 AI Engineer 创始人 Swyx 提醒大家刷社交媒体时保持清醒：你可以发“某某达到 SOTA 的概率归零”收获大量点赞，三个月后对方真的达到 SOTA，你再发一篇道歉获得更多点赞，被批评的人还会打印出来感谢你的激励。不准确没有任何代价，夸张却有全部激励，而 X 的算法正是为此调优的。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator President & CEO Garry Tan quoted Bostrom — "if nobody builds it, everyone dies" — and said he hard agrees.
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 引用 Bostrom 的话“如果没人去造它，所有人都会死”，并表示完全同意。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper asked who is working on stopping the infrastructure attacks happening right now, and how people in AI can help.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 发问：谁在帮助阻止当前正在发生的基础设施攻击？AI 圈的人可以怎么帮忙？
